source: made up: grad student teaching a 2 PM discussion section with a thesis chapter due Friday
persona: Devon, a PhD candidate in history with a discussion section to teach at 14:00 and Chapter 3 of their dissertation due to their advisor on Friday. Texts articulately but tends to procrastinate on dissertation writing by over-prepping for teaching or doing small campus errands. Honest when calling out their own avoidance.
situation: Wednesday morning waking at 08:00. Teaching HIST 102 discussion section 14:00–15:00 and holding office hours 15:00–16:00, with dissertation writing and reading quiz grading needed around it.
life: 08:10 Wake up and text the app: need to get to campus by 09:30, spend the morning on Chapter 3 section 2, prep slides/questions for the 14:00 section, eat lunch, teach 14:00–15:00, hold office hours 15:00–16:00, and grade 18 short reading quizzes before evening.
08:15 Eat oatmeal, shower, pack bag, and walk to the history department office, arriving at 09:30.
09:32 Tell the app morning routine and walk to campus are done. Start Chapter 3 writing block.
10:15 Get sidetracked digging through a JSTOR rabbit hole for a footnote; realize at 11:15 you've only written 150 words and haven't prepped discussion questions for the 14:00 section yet.
11:18 Text the app that writing is going slowly and ask to switch to section prep now (11:30–12:30), grab lunch at 12:30, and move the second Chapter 3 writing block to 16:30 after office hours.
11:25 Prep discussion questions and print primary source handouts in the department lounge until 12:35.
12:35 Grab a falafel wrap from the food truck with a cohort friend; chat runs until 13:30.
13:32 Report section prep and lunch done. Remind the app you need 30 minutes before teaching to review student forum posts and walk across the quad to the classroom.
13:35 Skim student forum posts and walk to Hall of Languages.
15:00 Hold office hours in the department basement; three students show up asking about midterm essay prompts, keeping you until 16:15.
16:18 Text the app: teaching and office hours done (ran 15 mins late). Need to return two overdue interlibrary loan books to the main library before the ILL desk closes at 17:00!
16:20 Walk to the library, drop off ILL books, and grab an iced espresso, finishing at 16:50.
16:55 Report ILL books returned. Ask how to fit both grading the 18 quizzes and 90 minutes of Chapter 3 writing before heading home for dinner around 20:00.
17:00 Sit in the quiet carrel and write Chapter 3 section 2 until 18:40 (finally hit a groove and get 750 words down).
18:42 Report Chapter 3 block went great! Start grading the 18 reading quizzes on Canvas.
19:45 Finish grading quizzes and entering scores. Tell the app grading is done and you're walking home.
20:15 Make pasta and eat dinner while watching a YouTube video until 21:00.
21:05 Report dinner done. Ask the app what tomorrow looks like and tell it to leave the rest of tonight free to read for pleasure.
constraints: Needs 30 minutes immediately before the 14:00 discussion section to skim student forum posts and walk across the quad.
Interlibrary Loan (ILL) desk at the main library closes at 17:00 sharp.
Writes dissertation chapters best in at least 90-minute uninterrupted stretches.

truth.item: Skim forum posts & walk to classroom
